name: TTLock smart lock
notes: TTLock (Sciener) smart locks advertise their primary service 0x1910; broadcast names look like <model>_<last 3 MAC bytes hex> (e.g. S534_1d22bd). The first two manufacturer-data bytes are a protocol header, not a company ID, so no MANUFACTURER_ID rule is used. Source: roquerodrigo/ttlock-ble (MIT).
